CATALOGUE.domain: connected Atlas gate followed by frozen named-family constructors through order 30

GENERIC.domain: 6000 deterministic connected G(n,p) proposals, orders 8 through 30

WALL_NAVIGATION.domain: frozen single-move perturbations of equality stars K1,m, 2 <= m <= 29

candidate_rule: explicit independent set I and rigorous rational upper bound RGA2_upper < |I|
d2_convention: cardinality of the closed distance-at-most-two ball, including the vertex itself
target: alpha(G) <= sum_{uv in E(G)} 2 sqrt(d2(u)d2(v))/(d2(u)+d2(v)) for nontrivial connected finite simple G
